description: This file defines an interface for accessing application environment statistics, specifically memory usage, within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: IAppEnvironmentStatistics
classes.description: An interface providing access to environment-related statistics, such as memory usage, with a deprecation note indicating it will be removed in favor of IEnvironmentStatisticsProvider.

methods.name: MemoryUsage
methods.description: A nullable property returning the total memory usage in bytes, if available.
